programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 1 Hls Highlights from Stage 1 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Riders tackle challenging Karoo climbs, rugged gravel roads, and spectacular semi-desert scenery.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 2 Hls Highlights from Stage 2 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Riders take on demanding loop routes, iconic Karoo landscapes, and fierce gravel racing.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 3 Hls Highlights from Stage 3 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. The longest stage of the race delivers mountain passes, rolling terrain, and relentless competition.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 4 Hls Highlights from Stage 4 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. A shorter tactical stage reshapes the battle as riders push for position across Karoo gravel roads.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 5 Hls Highlights from Stage 5 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Fast gravel, remote landscapes, and accumulated fatigue test riders deep into the race.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 6 Hls Highlights from Stage 6 of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Riders transition from open Karoo plains to bushveld terrain on the road to Shamwari.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn: Stage 7 Hls Highlights from Stage 7 – the final stage – of the Nedbank Gravel Burn, a 7-day, 750km gravel cycling race from Graaff-Reinet to Shamwari. Racing through Big 5 territory, riders reach the Indian Ocean before the finale.
programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.desc: 'S26/E1 of 5 - Belief'. Chiefs relive the cup final that ended their drought and the young man the fans had turned on. Ouaddou walks into a club that has gone fourteen years without a league title and loses his first two games.
programme.title: GIANTS

programme.title: GIANTS

programme.title: GIANTS

programme.desc: 'S26/E4 of 5 - Endurance'. Two Derbies. One hour of football that decides a season. Pirates arrive beaten, praying Makgopa is fit. Chiefs arrive wounded: out of CAF, out of Nedbank. 90 minutes, twice, decide who is left in the title race.
programme.title: GIANTS

programme.title: GIANTS

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.
programme.title: Babe

programme.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.
programme.title: Small Soldiers

programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.
programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike

programme.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. When a mysterious, rich and charming stranger buys a mansion in the community, it looks like their prayers have been answered - but the man they appear to have summoned seems more than a little devilish. Based on John Updike's novel.
programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
programme.title: Hook

programme.desc: A new kid at a school is targeted by a school bully and his gang and seeks help from a handyman, who is also a karate master. With gruelling training and much patience, the young man learns martial arts from the handyman.
programme.title: The Karate Kid

programme.desc: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.
programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II

programme.desc: A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.
programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III

programme.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.
programme.title: Liar Liar

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.
programme.title: Kindergarten Cop

programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).
programme.title: The Wedding Singer

programme.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
programme.title: Sixteen Candles

programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.
programme.title: Caddyshack

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.
programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.
programme.title: Tootsie

programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.
programme.title: Risky Business

programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling

programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.
programme.title: The 'Burbs

programme.desc: In 1940, with a German invasion looming, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of local bank manager Captain Mainwaring and a motley collection of volunteers. After a series of blunders, the Home Guard finally gets the glory they deserve.
programme.title: Dad's Army

programme.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

Jeannine was brought up just opposite the pub, and this antique pinball machine now provides a tangible link to her predecessors.

programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

Penny feels so guilty that Sheldon has missed out on the opportunity to meet Stan Lee that she finds out his home address and takes Sheldon there.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E17 — The Precious Fragmentation The gang squabble over a ring which they believe was used in 'The Lord of the Rings'. Can the guys reach an agreement and will Sheldon return to normal?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E18 — The Pants Alternative Sheldon has been awarded a prestigious prize by the university but is scared of collecting the gong at a ceremony because he knows he'll have to give a speech. Penny tries to gee Sheldon up using rousing references to "X-Men" and Leonard and Koothrappali offer psychological guidance without much success. On the night, Sheldon's nerves get the better of him, and he has a drink before going on stage.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E20 — The Spaghetti Catalyst Sheldon tries to hide his friendship with Penny from Leonard, but it isn't long before his double life is exposed to Penny and Leonard. Can Penny and Leonard keep their friendships with Sheldon without hurting each other?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
